decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - All advertisements displays, and any site used for the display of advertisements shall be maintained in a clean and tidy condition to the reasonable satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 2 - Any structure or hoarding erected or used principally for the purpose of displaying advertisements shall be maintained in a safe condition.
Condition : 3 - Where any advertisement is required under these regulations to be removed, the removal shall be carried out to the reasonable satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 4 - No advertisement is to be displayed without the permission of the owner of the site or any other person with an interest in the site entitled to grant planning permission.

Condition : 5 - No advertisment shall be sited or displayed so as to obscure, or hinder, the ready interpretation of any road sign, railway sign or aid to navigation by water or air so as to otherwise render hazardous the use of any highway, railway, waterway ( including any coastal waters) or aerodrome (civil or military).

Condition : 6 - Not more than six words shall be incorporated in any advertising message to be displayed on this site, unless otherwise agreed in writing with the local planning authority in conjunction with the Highway Authorities. For the avoidance of doubt, the advertising contractors name shall count as two words of the message if it is visible from the M4 motorway.

Condition : 7 - The displays on the internally illuminated poster panel on the east facing elevation hereby permitted shall be static only, with no moving or apparently moving images, devices, wording or emblems, unless otherwise agreed in writing with the local planning authority in conjunction with the Highway Authorities.

Condition : 8 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used m the construction of the external surfaces of the structure hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.
description: Installation of replacement illuminated LUCOZADE Bottle Sign panel to western elevation of York House, together with the installation of 1x internally illuminated panel for general advertising to eastern elevation of York House. (Both advertisements rely on proposed office extension application P5).
